Cassie: opened a docs PR to update runtime telemetry examples and add export-redaction snippets: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1407
Alex: thumbs up. are we changing field names or just adding redaction guidance?
Cassie: both. examples now use "pseudonymous_id" and an explicit "tenant_id". adding pre-export redaction examples that HMAC tenant_id (KMS-managed salt) and a small allowlist so routing keys stay intact.
Jordan: can you paste the short Go snippet? i'll mirror it in the runtime hook.
Cassie: added this minimal example in the PR: ```// redact hashes tenant_id and removes free-text before export
func redact(evt map[string]interface{}, salt string) map[string]interface{} {
  if v, ok := evt["tenant_id"].(string); ok {
    mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(salt))
    mac.Write([]byte(v))
    evt["tenant_id"] = fmt.Sprintf("hmac:%x", mac.Sum(nil))
  }
  delete(evt, "raw_prompt")
  return evt
}```
Maria: legal note: avoid "PII" in public docs. use "sensitive identifiers" and list examples.
Lee (Compliance): also call out that routing keys (region, zone) must not be redacted. link to Audit Retention page instead of giving TTLs. add compliance sign-off checkbox on the PR.
Cassie: done. added allowlist comment and KMS reference. left a TODO for a unit test.
